remarks: Fantastic, turn-key condo in sought after Glenbrook location! Large open living room with gorgeous floors open to the dining area. Head through the slider out to the lovely deck to enjoy your morning coffee. Galley style kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, tile floors and backsplash, and solid wood cabinetry. Storage abounds in the row of closets along one side of the unit! Beautifully renovated bathroom with stylish vanity and stunning tub and dazzling tile! Enjoy sweet dreams in the comfortable bedroom with hardwood floors and ceiling fan. This great condo community has an in-ground pool, play ground area and plenty of guest parking. Large storage area in the basement. Great proximity to all that Stamford has to offer!
